_comment: THE FINISHER IS IN HAND, NOT ON THE BOARD -- the user's *'blue or black'* clause. Dimensional
Infiltrator costs {1}{U} and the Kitchen makes the blue; the board otherwise is fixture 1's.
Two mechanisms carry this one and neither is new: ScanHandSinks prices the cast as a one-off
hand_setup_mv (through BlinkActivationCounts' human bank-count bypass, so a count is offered at
all), and ComboFinishFromHand deploys it inside the loop -- which it is allowed to do ONLY
inside ComboOffFinishActive(), i.e. only because the human pressed the button. What the fixture
guards is that the two agree: the count is sized for the deploy route AND the deploy really
happens, so the promise the button makes is the line the apply runs.
